findings.issue: Step 2 (name/title-shaped key match) returns the key on name match alone, without checking deriveFieldType — so a title-like-named field that is itself non-scalar (enum/date/etc.) can be selected. pickSampleValue still degrades gracefully for that one row (falls through to the generic scan when the value is blank/non-scalar), so this is not a defect, just a documented tradeoff (explicitly called out by the module's own unit test 'step 2 fires before step 3 even looks at types'). No action required.
findings.suggestion: None — informational; leaving here for the record in case a future registry surfaces a real-world case where a title-named enum field produces a less-useful sample than the step-3 textual fallback would have.
